standards.title: Electric storage water heaters - Specification
standards.scope: Specifies construction, performance, safety and marking requirements for electric storage type water heaters intended for operation on a 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase AC supply, with rated storage capacities from 50 L to 5000 L, installed in domestic, institutional, commercial and industrial premises.

conditions.text: Applies to electric storage type water heaters (geysers) only.
conditions.question: Please specify the product being procured.

conditions.label: Capacity
conditions.text: Rated storage capacity shall be not less than 50 L and not more than 5000 L.
conditions.question: Please specify the rated storage capacity in litres.

conditions.label: Voltage
conditions.text: Applies to water heaters rated for a single-phase AC supply of 220-240 V, 50 Hz.
conditions.question: Please specify the rated supply voltage.

conditions.label: Application
conditions.text: Covers installations in domestic, institutional, commercial and industrial premises.
